item.title: A Utopian City should be inspired by Circuits
item.description: Establishing the Scene I was recently in New York. What an amazing city! I was walking on the streets of Manhattan, and I realized how efficient the city is. I was stunned by the architecture, the busy vibe, the amazing pizza and, of course, the beautiful women. Note that I call the city efficient. It’s a strange way to describe a city. In fact, it almost felt like the city had life.

item.title: About
item.description: This is a small place on the internet I created for myself to write. I consider myself and embedded software engineer, with interest in music, coding, cryptography and nature. My primary goal is to write techincal articles about things I have learnt. I want to write about things the way I percieved them. The idea is to make it as simple and as short as possible for everyone on the internet.
